questions.question_text: Jīv em samaje je, 'Māru swarūp to māyā thakī mukt ne par evu je ______ te chhe.'
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states: Jīv em samaje je, 'Māru swarūp to māyā thakī mukt ne par evu je brahma te chhe.'

questions.question_text: Potānā jīvātmāne e brahma sangāthe ekatā karīne Parabrahmanī ______ upāsanā karvī.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states: Potānā jīvātmāne e brahma sangāthe ekatā karīne Parabrahmanī swāmī-sevakbhāve upāsanā karvī.

questions.question_text: Dehe karīne kriyā karto hoy ne potānu rūp judu samajīne bhajan karto hoy to bahu ______ thāy, paṇ kriyārūp thaīne temā bhaḷī jāy to ṭhīk nahī.
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato states: Dehe karīne kriyā karto hoy ne potānu rūp judu samajīne bhajan karto hoy to bahu samās thāy, paṇ kriyārūp thaīne temā bhaḷī jāy to ṭhīk nahī.

questions.question_text: Jeṭlu kāī ______ sukh chhe te sarve duhkha vinānu hoy nahi.
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato states: Jeṭlu kāī māyāmay sukh chhe te sarve duhkha vinānu hoy nahi.

questions.question_text: Ne sānkhya vinā lobh, kām, swād, sneh ne mān e pānch dosh tathā adhyātma, adhibhūt ne ______ e traṇ tāp e sarvenu duhkha maṭe nahī.
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato states: Ne sānkhya vinā lobh, kām, swād, sneh ne mān e pānch dosh tathā adhyātma, adhibhūt ne adhidev e traṇ tāp e sarvenu duhkha maṭe nahī.
Swamini Vato states: Ne sānkhya vinā ardho satsang kahevāy.

questions.question_text: Ā deh ______, strīno deh paṇ hāḍkāno ne chhokrāno paṇ hāḍkāno, emā kāīye māl nathī.
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato states: Ā deh hāḍkāno, strīno deh paṇ hāḍkāno ne chhokrāno paṇ hāḍkāno, emā kāīye māl nathī.

questions.question_text: Deh dhūḍno, rūpiyā dhūḍnā, kuṭumbī dhūḍnā, ______ dhūḍnu, khorḍā dhūḍnā em chhe.
questions.explanation: Swamini Vato states: Deh dhūḍno, rūpiyā dhūḍnā, kuṭumbī dhūḍnā, khāvu dhūḍnu, khorḍā dhūḍnā em chhe.

questions.question_text: Temā ek to em je, āpaṇe ā dehne mūkīne jarūr marī javu chhe ne teno vilamb nathī jaṇāto, e to em ja nishchay jaṇāy chhe je, 'Ā ghaḍī, ______ āpaṇe marvu chhe.'
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut states: Temā ek to em je, āpaṇe ā dehne mūkīne jarūr marī javu chhe ne teno vilamb nathī jaṇāto, e to em ja nishchay jaṇāy chhe je, 'Ā ghaḍī, ā kshaṇmā āpaṇe marvu chhe.'

questions.question_text: Ā pānch ______ amāre nitye nirantar anusandhān rahe chhe.
questions.explanation: Vachanamrut states: Ā pānch vārtānu amāre nitye nirantar anusandhān rahe chhe.
